'''Merean Tihomar''' was the first Queen of [[Shienar]] and the founder of that nation.

== History ==
Tihomar was the Imperial Governor for the Province of [[Shienar]] during the latter part of the reign of [[Artur Hawkwing]], the High King. Upon his death in FY 994, Tihomar and the other [[Borderlands|Borderland]] Province rulers met to discuss what they should do as the rest of the Empire began to disintegrate in the [[War of the Hundred Years]]. The five provinces became independent nation-states, allied together against both the threat of the [[Blight]] to the north and also from attack by the southern kingdoms. They were able to subsequently ride out the chaos of the wars with minimal violence.{{ref|{{TWoTRPG}}}}
